tools.name: pitch-find-clubs
tools.description: Search the PNW Pitch youth soccer club directory for Washington, Oregon, Idaho and western Montana. Filter by region, county or city, tier (Elite, Competitive, Recreational), league (for example ECNL, MLS NEXT, Girls Academy), gender, or free-text words. Returns each club's location, tier, leagues,

tools.name: pitch-list-areas
tools.description: The areas the PNW Pitch club directory covers (Washington, Oregon, Idaho and western Montana), with the number of listed clubs in each. Use these names with pitch/find-clubs.

tools.name: pitch-search-guides
tools.description: Search published PNW Pitch guides, articles and pages: tryouts, leagues, tournaments, camps, costs, gear, standings recaps and club spotlights.

tools.name: pitch-get-page
tools.description: Full text of one published PNW Pitch page or article, as plain text with headings. Pass the URL or slug. Long pages come back in parts: pass next_offset as offset to continue.

tools.name: pitch-whats-new
tools.description: Articles and pages on PNW Pitch published since a date (default: last 30 days), newest first: standings recaps, club spotlights, tryout and tournament updates.

tools.name: pitch-about
tools.description: What PNW Pitch covers, the other Pitch Network regional sites, and how to cite it.

tools.name: pitch-find-tournament
tools.description: Search the Pitch Network tournament registry by name, host club, city or date range. Returns dates, venue, platform and whether Scout can read its brackets. Use the id with pitch/scout-tournament. Defaults to this site's region; pass region "all" to search every Pitch Network region.

tools.name: pitch-scout-tournament
tools.description: For one tournament, gender, age and flight: every group and team, each matched to its real league team with a confidence label (Confirmed, Strong match, Likely match, or Check: can't confirm accuracy) and the evidence, its level (Elite or Competitive), W-D-L, goal difference, rank where ranked, leag

tools.name: pitch-resolve-team
tools.description: Turn a team name as a tournament lists it (for example "City SC BU14 EA" or "Vaqueros BU14 Premier") into the real league team, with a confidence label, the evidence, and the other candidates when more than one fits. Searches every Pitch Network region. Pass age and gender when the name does not inc

tools.name: pitch-team-card
tools.description: One team's league record, rank, league link and the club's other teams at that age, strongest league first. Pass a team id from pitch/resolve-team or pitch/scout-tournament.
